findings.heading: Troubleshooting common errors / Dépannage des erreurs courantes
findings.proposition: The English quotes the literal LaTeX error text a reader will see, '! Package pdftex.def Error: File '...' not found: using draft setting.'; the French presents it as half-translated output, '! Paquet pdftex.def Erreur : File '...' non trouvé : utilisation de la fonction brouillon.', which pdftex never emits (it is English-only, and 'draft setting' is an option, not a 'fonction brouillon').
findings.reader_consequence: A French reader matching the error in their console or .log file against the handbook string finds no match, and a web search for 'Paquet pdftex.def Erreur' returns nothing, so they cannot confirm they have this error.

findings.heading: Troubleshooting common errors / Dépannage des erreurs courantes
findings.proposition: The English says the Pandoc Error 83 message looks like `can't find file...rmarkdown...lua...`; the French says it looks like `Impossible de trouver le fichier...rmarkdown...lua...`, but Pandoc emits this message only in English.
findings.reader_consequence: A French reader will not recognise the English message Pandoc actually prints as the error described here, so they skip the correct diagnosis section for error 83.

findings.heading: Troubleshooting common errors / Dépannage des erreurs courantes
findings.proposition: The English quotes the literal Pandoc failure text `Error: pandoc document conversion failed with error 61`; the French quotes `Erreur : la conversion du document pandoc a échoué avec l'erreur 61`, a message Pandoc/rmarkdown does not produce.
findings.reader_consequence: A French reader cannot match the console output to this section, and searching the quoted French string online returns nothing, so the fix for error 61 is harder to reach.

findings.heading: Useful commands / Commandes utiles
findings.proposition: In English 'Useful commands' is a level-2 section, a sibling of 'Overview', 'RStudio as administrator' and 'Troubleshooting common errors'; in French 'Commandes utiles' is level 3, so it becomes a subsection of 'RStudio en tant qu'administrateur'.
findings.reader_consequence: The French table of contents nests the diagnostic commands under the run-as-administrator topic, so a reader scanning the chapter outline for library-path and Pandoc commands does not see them as a top-level topic.
